name: Easily use Spark Structured Streaming with Fabric Eventstream
description: Eventstream now integrates with Fabric Spark, letting data engineers and scientists consume and process stream data in notebooks and Spark jobs. This unifies real-time intelligence with Spark in a single end-to-end experience.With this capability, you can:- Discover and consume Eventstream data directly from Fabric notebooks.- Process streaming data with Spark Structured Streaming jobs.- Build real-time analytics and AI applications on live event data.

result.nameEs: Spark Structured Streaming con Fabric Eventstream de forma sencilla
result.descriptionEs:
Eventstream se integra con Fabric Spark para consumir y procesar datos en streaming desde notebooks y Spark jobs:
* Descubre y consume datos de Eventstream desde los notebooks.
* Procésalos con Spark Structured Streaming.
* Crea análisis y aplicaciones de IA sobre eventos en vivo.
